problems.locator: PDF p. 3, Experiment 1, Methods
problems.quote: Once participants finished the search task, they proceeded to write their advice on the topic within the survey.
problems.note: The required question classification cannot be confirmed from the paper. Codebook sections 1 and 6 distinguish AI available during output production from AI removed before production. The methods establish search followed by writing, but do not establish whether the AI interface or supplied source content remained available during writing. The instruments do not settle that distinction; prohibiting copied-and-pasted advice does not establish removal of AI. The existing null is a documented evidence gap, not a demonstrated wrong classification. Keep question and outcome_with_ai null pending evidence; do not assign after_ai merely from task order. This leaves the estimate unresolved under extraction rule 4(b).

problems.locator: Supplement PDF p. 6, Consequential-topic replication, Method (study total and exclusions); Supplement PDF p. 7, Results (outcome analysis)
problems.quote: cosine similarity: MGoogle = 0.174, MGPT = 0.370; F(1, 1971) = 397.07, p < .001
problems.note: The value 1,976 is printed as the final study sample on supplement p. 6 and main PDF p. 5, so it is not a transcription error. However, the outcome-specific analyzed people count cannot be confirmed: each outcome test uses denominator df = 1971, inconsistent with an ordinary full-sample two-group analysis of that stated total. The supplement also prints 2,129 randomized, 24 exclusions and another 130 exclusions, which do not reconcile with its final total. Extraction rule 7 requires the people in the analysis producing this statistic. Retain 1,976 as the reported study-level n_analyzed with the discrepancy noted, but leave estimate-level n_total null until the analysis count is established. Do not derive a replacement count from degrees of freedom or exclusion arithmetic. The extraction already documents the discrepancy, but still places the unconfirmed study total in this analysis-level field.

summary: Checked all 33 estimates: S1 4, S2 4, S3 9, S5 12 and S6 4. Read the complete main markdown (398 lines) and supplement markdown (1320 lines), covering all 11 main-PDF pages and all 49 supplement pages, and extracted every cited estimate-source page with PyMuPDF. All 61 estimate-source quotations match their exact cited PDF pages after whitespace/discretionary-hyphen normalization; all recorded numerical values match the printed values and outcome/arm labels. The supplement-quote warnings are false positives: the S5 quotations are on supplement PDF p. 5 and S6 quotations are on pp. 6-7. The text_features warnings are also false positives: that category is explicitly allowed by the supplied current codebook section 6 and extraction specification, and correctly describes spaCy tagged-word/entity counts. The 37 findings are unresolved verification issues, not numeric mistranscriptions: 33 estimates cannot be assigned a supported question/outcome_with_ai classification, and four S6 estimate-level analysis totals cannot be established from the inconsistent reporting. No supported substitute values or classifications were invented. Remaining constructs, measures, units or documented unknown units, directions, immediate timing, writer-level within_person coding, comparisons and se_basis classifications are consistent with the methods. S2 is an AI-design comparison because both arms receive GPT-4o-generated content; recipient ratings of S3 outputs do not add an independent randomized writer sample. The S3 relative-helpfulness percentages and confidence limits reproduce the printed labels despite the paper's contradictory narrative; no reversal or unit conversion is warranted from the PDF alone. Its chi-square statistic is explicitly identified in the extraction as a choice-distribution test including ties, not a two-condition mean-difference test. S5 omnibus tests are correctly kept out of pairwise test fields, and its overall three-arm sample is not substituted for two-arm totals. No additional clearly eligible output outcome or full-sample contrast was found under rules 4-6. Self-reports, recommendation/adoption intentions, process outcomes, mediation and post-treatment-adjusted analyses are appropriately skipped. The supplementary mattress-advice recipient study does not establish randomization of its source writers, so its exclusion is supported. The extraction input was not changed.
